name: Katsuragi Souya
source:
Champion of the previous year's tournament. 
Captain of the Superpower Club of the high school connected to Hakurouin University.
Though he may seem gentlemanly he's a fighting maniac and a formidable opponent. His flaw is that sometimes he can act a bit airheaded.
He has the superpower "Kings Double" which he can use to create copies of himself.
